page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred. Printed page number at the top right. Catchword at the foot, right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: gitationes fuggerit: Quousq; conflictaberis[?] cum exilij & cum paupertatis incommodis? Quamdiu tandem contumeliofq; uoces de inobedientia & contumacia erga praeceptores, ut aiunt, bene meritos & alios, tibi ferendae erunt? Cur non mittis ad iniquitatem manus tuas, Psal.125.3. ut aliqua saltem malorum relaxatione, & uitae huius adminiculorum parte, tandem aliquando potiaris?

3. Porro, si per patientia possidere nos decet animas nostras, cur acerbissimum istum multiplicium, quibus laboras, malorum sensum tibi Deus ille tuus, in quo speras, non mitigat, ut tolerabilior sit, cum eum auferre nolit? Itane delectatur tuis miseriis & angoribus?
main_text.head: Exempla.
main_text.p: Iobus:Pereat, dicebat ille, dies in qua natus sum, & nox quae dixit: Conceptus est nir[?]. Dies illa sit tenebrae: non requirat illam Deus desuper, nec splendeat super illam lux, & c. Iob.3.3. & sequentibus. Ieremias:Vae mihi mater mea, quod genuisti me, virum rixae & virum discordię toti terrę:non foeneravi eis, nec foenerati sunt mihi: omnes maledicunt mihi. Ier.15.10.

page.notes: The page number "191" is partly unclear in the scan; read as 191. "conflictaberis" is inferred from a ligature and a line break with no visible hyphen. "nir" in Job 3:3 is unclear; the Vulgate has "vir", and the printed letters are left as read. "Quousq;" and the other long s forms are written with a plain s. The paragraph beginning "3." is a running paragraph, not a heading. The catchword "Vt au-" is the start of the next page.
